visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair wearing a dark green jacket sits on a light-colored sofa, holding a small pink cake decorated with white frosting and a number '6' candle. A large white Samoyed dog stands beside him, its face close to the cake. The room is softly lit with warm indoor lighting. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of the Samoyed's face, showing its dark eyes and black nose as it intently watches the candle. (3) A series of quick cuts shows the dog in various outdoor locations: looking out a car window at a forest, walking along a white wall on a grassy path, and sitting in a car wearing a festive Toy Story-themed bandana. (4) Footage of the dog as a small puppy is shown, followed by the dog wearing a red Santa hat indoors. (5) The man and the dog are seen on a rocky pier by the sea during sunset; the man hugs the dog's neck. (6) Extreme close-ups highlight the dog's wet black nose, its tongue licking its snout, and its eyes looking at the camera. The video concludes with the man and dog in a car, the dog panting happily with its tongue out.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 今天是妳6歲的生日哦. [Logo]: Happy Birthday. [Variety]: Pumpkin. (2) [Subtitle]: 也是妳當小狗的第2,191天. (3) [Subtitle]: 還記得小時候妳呆呆的樣子. (4) [Subtitle]: 每次走路的時候, 都一定要衝在我前面, 急著想要探索這個世界的模樣. (5) [Subtitle]: 時間過得好快. (6) [Subtitle]: 那些小時候的回憶, 彷彿就像是昨天. (7) [Subtitle]: 昨天. (8) [Subtitle]: 有人問, 如果明知道和寵物的相遇時間是有限的, 妳會後悔嗎? (9) [Subtitle]: 但是靠著妳毛茸茸的身體, 聞著妳身上的味道, 濕濕的鼻子, 圓滾滾的眼睛. (10) [Subtitle]: 原來幸福就是有妳在的每一分每一秒, 每一個瞬間. (11) [Subtitle]: 生日快樂, 願妳能一直健健康康的喔, 南瓜.
